title: Continual Learning
definition: The ability of a machine learning model to learn from multiple tasks sequentially, without catastrophic forgetting of previously learned tasks.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A machine learning technique that lets a model learn from many tasks over time, without forgetting what it has already learned.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A machine learning approach that allows a model to adapt to new tasks while retaining its knowledge of previous tasks, addressing the issue of catastrophic forgetting.
difficulty_levels.expert: An exploration of the challenges and potential solutions for enabling machine learning models to learn continuously from multiple tasks, without compromising their ability to generalize and reason.

extra_fields.insight: Continual learning is crucial for building intelligent systems that can adapt to a rapidly changing world.
